title: Are you using the wrong combination for your strategy?
subtitle: From ETF accumulation plans and stock picking to forex and index trading, TradeScope cross-matches asset, strategy, horizon, capital, and leverage against a real cost database to find the most efficient instrument.
cta_note: Asset, strategy, horizon. Then the ranking.
trust: The engine reads asset, strategy, horizon, capital, and leverage, then compares real spreads, funding, TER, and commissions before ranking brokers and instruments.
visual_note: The same asset may require different instruments once strategy and holding horizon change.
monitor_row_1_note: Here drag comes mainly from TER, recurring orders, and account structure.
monitor_row_2_note: On position trades, holding cost and wrapper choice can matter almost as much as the ticker.
monitor_row_3_note: Execution quality, spread, and rollover decide setup efficiency.
